turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have twenty minutes, Hale, and a client call at 4:40. Owen's zero went into the gradebook and he found out on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided that, and why didn't anyone call me first?
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
That's fine, Hale. I'll want a copy of the recording in writing. Now answer on the record: who entered the zero?
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.
I haven't said a word about legal action, Hale. I'm writing down that you raised a union complaint before you answered a single question. I'm still waiting for a name and a time.
"Choose your words carefully." I've done this for twenty years, Hale, and I'm choosing them fine. Your policy says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me.
